proof_summary: Define an auxiliary sequence by \(b_0=2\), \(b_1=56\), and \(b_{n+2}=-4b_{n+1}-64b_n\). A simultaneous induction using the fourth-order recurrence proves \(a_{2n+1}=b_n^2\) together with the bridging identities \(a_{2n+2}=b_nb_{n+1}+64^{n+1}\) (and their one-step shifts), from which every odd-indexed term is a square.
